decisions.title: Use Dafny for core logic
decisions.context: Core modules handle patient data, clinical records, billing, and FHIR conversion. Correctness is critical.
decisions.decision: Implement all core logic in Dafny with Z3-verified contracts.
decisions.consequences: High assurance of correctness, but requires Dafny expertise and may increase development time.

decisions.title: Use FHIR R4 as interoperability standard
decisions.context: The system must exchange patient data with external healthcare systems.
decisions.decision: Adopt HL7 FHIR R4 as the primary data exchange format.
decisions.consequences: Standardized interoperability, but requires mapping between internal models and FHIR resources.

decisions.title: Separate I/O from core logic
decisions.context: Dafny cannot directly perform I/O; side effects must be isolated.
decisions.decision: Use io-shell components for all I/O, with Dafny core modules calling extern stubs.
decisions.consequences: Clear separation of concerns, but requires careful interface design.

openRisks.mitigation: Use proven transformer patterns and validate FHIR resources early.
openRisks.description: FHIR resource complexity may require extensive mapping logic.

openRisks.mitigation: Implement comprehensive audit trails and enforce role-based access controls.
openRisks.description: HIPAA compliance requires rigorous audit and access control.

openRisks.mitigation: Use proven registry patterns and keep modules small and focused.
openRisks.description: Dafny verification may increase development time for complex modules.

components.name: PatientRegistry
components.internals: Uses repository pattern for patient entity storage. Validates required demographic fields and unique patient ID. No I/O; persistence is handled by an io-shell component.

testCases.name: RegisterPatientCreatesRecord
testCases.description: Register a new patient with valid demographics.
testCases.expectedBehavior: RegisterPatient returns a Patient with a unique patientId and the record is retrievable via GetPatient.

testCases.name: RegisterPatientRejectsDuplicateId
testCases.description: Attempt to register a patient with an existing patientId.
testCases.expectedBehavior: RegisterPatient fails with an error indicating duplicate patient ID.

testCases.name: UpdatePatientChangesDemographics
testCases.description: Update an existing patient's last name.
testCases.expectedBehavior: UpdatePatient succeeds and GetPatient returns the updated last name.

components.responsibility: Manages patient registration, demographics, and patient identity lifecycle. Provides CRUD operations for patient records and enforces unique patient identifiers.

components.name: ClinicalRecords
components.internals: Uses pipeline pattern to process clinical record additions through validation and transformation. Each record is associated with a patientId and timestamp.

testCases.name: AddMedicalHistoryValidRecord
testCases.description: Add a valid medical history entry for an existing patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: AddMedicalHistory succeeds and the entry appears in GetClinicalHistory.

testCases.name: AddPrescriptionValidRecord
testCases.description: Add a valid prescription for an existing patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: AddPrescription succeeds and the prescription appears in GetClinicalHistory.

testCases.name: AddLabResultValidRecord
testCases.description: Add a valid lab result for an existing patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: AddLabResult succeeds and the lab result appears in GetClinicalHistory.

testCases.name: RejectRecordForUnknownPatient
testCases.description: Attempt to add a clinical record for a non-existent patientId.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The operation fails with an error indicating the patient does not exist.

components.responsibility: Tracks medical history, prescriptions, and lab results for patients. Maintains chronological clinical records and enforces data integrity.

components.name: AppointmentScheduler
components.internals: Uses scheduler pattern to manage appointment queue and state transitions (scheduled, rescheduled, cancelled).

testCases.name: ScheduleAppointmentValid
testCases.description: Schedule an appointment for an existing patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ScheduleAppointment succeeds and the appointment is retrievable via GetAppointments.

testCases.name: RescheduleAppointmentChangesTime
testCases.description: Reschedule an existing appointment to a new time.
testCases.expectedBehavior: RescheduleAppointment succeeds and the appointment time is updated.

testCases.name: CancelAppointmentMarksCancelled
testCases.description: Cancel an existing appointment.
testCases.expectedBehavior: CancelAppointment succeeds and the appointment status is 'cancelled'.

testCases.name: RejectAppointmentForUnknownPatient
testCases.description: Attempt to schedule an appointment for a non-existent patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ScheduleAppointment fails with an error indicating the patient does not exist.

components.responsibility: Manages appointment scheduling, rescheduling, and cancellation. Enforces that appointments are associated with valid patients and providers.

components.name: BillingEngine
components.internals: Uses state-machine pattern to manage invoice and claim lifecycle (draft, submitted, paid, denied).

testCases.name: GenerateInvoiceValid
testCases.description: Generate an invoice for a patient with clinical services.
testCases.expectedBehavior: GenerateInvoice succeeds and the invoice is in 'draft' state.

testCases.name: SubmitClaimTransitionsToSubmitted
testCases.description: Submit a claim for a valid invoice.
testCases.expectedBehavior: SubmitClaim succeeds and the claim state becomes 'submitted'.

testCases.name: ProcessPaymentMarksPaid
testCases.description: Process a payment for an invoice.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ProcessPayment succeeds and the invoice state becomes 'paid'.

testCases.name: RejectClaimForUnknownPatient
testCases.description: Attempt to submit a claim for a non-existent patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: SubmitClaim fails with an error indicating the patient does not exist.

components.responsibility: Generates invoices, processes payments, and prepares insurance claim submissions. Tracks billing status and claim state.

components.name: FHIRIntegration
components.internals: Uses transformer pattern to map internal records to FHIR resources and back. Validation ensures FHIR conformance.

testCases.name: ConvertPatientToFHIR
testCases.description: Convert a valid internal Patient to a FHIR Patient resource.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ConvertToFHIR returns a FHIRResource with type 'Patient' and matching demographics.

testCases.name: ConvertFHIRToPatient
testCases.description: Convert a valid FHIR Patient resource to an internal Patient.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ConvertFromFHIR returns a Patient with matching demographics.

testCases.name: ValidateInvalidFHIRRejected
testCases.description: Validate a FHIR resource with missing required fields.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ValidateFHIR returns false and the conversion fails.

components.responsibility: Converts internal records to and from HL7 FHIR format. Validates FHIR resources and maps them to internal domain models.

components.name: AuditTrail
components.internals: Uses pipeline pattern to process audit events through validation and storage. Each entry is immutable.

testCases.name: LogAccessCreatesEntry
testCases.description: Log an access event with actor, action, resource, and timestamp.
testCases.expectedBehavior: LogAccess succeeds and the entry appears in GetAuditLog.

testCases.name: AuditEntryImmutable
testCases.description: Attempt to modify an existing audit entry.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Audit entries cannot be modified; the system rejects any update attempt.

components.responsibility: Records access audit trails for all system interactions. Captures actor, action, resource, and timestamp for HIPAA compliance.

components.name: PatientStore
components.internals: I/O shell wrapping a relational database. Uses database-io stubs for persistence.

testCases.name: SaveAndLoadPatient
testCases.description: Save a patient record and load it back.
testCases.expectedBehavior: SavePatient succeeds and LoadPatient returns the same patient data.

testCases.name: SaveAndLoadClinicalRecord
testCases.description: Save a clinical record and load it back.
testCases.expectedBehavior: SaveClinicalRecord succeeds and LoadClinicalRecords returns the saved record.

components.responsibility: Persists patient and clinical records to a database. Provides CRUD operations for the repository layer.

components.name: FHIRGateway
components.internals: ASP.NET Core Web API exposing FHIR endpoints. Uses network-io stubs for HTTP handling.

testCases.name: PostFHIRPatient
testCases.description: POST a FHIR Patient resource to the gateway.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The gateway returns 201 Created and the patient is registered.

testCases.name: GetFHIRPatient
testCases.description: GET a FHIR Patient resource by ID.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The gateway returns 200 OK with the FHIR Patient resource.

components.responsibility: Provides an HTTP API for FHIR resource exchange. Accepts inbound FHIR requests and returns FHIR responses.

components.name: AdminCLI
components.internals: Console application using console-io stubs. Parses commands and delegates to core modules.

testCases.name: ViewAuditLog
testCases.description: Run the CLI command to view audit logs.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The CLI prints the audit log entries to the console.

testCases.name: GenerateBillingReport
testCases.description: Run the CLI command to generate a billing report.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The CLI prints the billing report summary to the console.

components.responsibility: Provides a command-line interface for administrative operations such as viewing audit logs and triggering billing reports.

dataStores.name: PatientDatabase
dataStores.schema: Patients, ClinicalRecords, Appointments, Invoices, Claims, AuditLogs

auth.details: Bearer tokens with scopes for patient, clinical, billing, and admin access.

systemContext: A HIPAA-compliant patient records management system supporting patient registration, medical history tracking, appointment scheduling, prescription management, lab results processing, billing, and insurance claim submission. It handles HL7 FHIR data format, maintains access audit trails, and is organized into Patient, Clinical, Billing, Scheduling, and Integration modules.

qualityAttributes.rationale: Patient data must be protected with access controls, encryption, and audit trails.
HIPAA requires detailed audit trails for all access to protected health information.
Supports exchange of patient data with external systems using the HL7 FHIR standard.
Clinical and billing operations require high availability.

deploymentTopology: Single web application with a REST API, a console admin tool, and a relational database. All components deployed in a HIPAA-compliant cloud environment with encryption in transit and at rest.
